info.name: SAP Ariba Procurement Invoices Purchase Order Line Items API
List Line Items for a Purchase Order

params.name: realm
params.description: The SAP Ariba realm identifier for the buyer organization. This is the unique site name assigned during provisioning.

params.name: orderId
params.description: Unique purchase order identifier (UniqueName). This is the purchase order number with its version, or the ERP PO number (ERPPONumber).

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default 0)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (default 10, max 100)

items.docs: Retrieves all line items associated with a specific purchase order including item details, quantities, pricing, delivery schedules, commodity codes, and accounting assignments.

params.name: realm
params.description: The SAP Ariba realm identifier for the buyer organization. This is the unique site name assigned during provisioning.

params.name: orderId
params.description: Unique purchase order identifier (UniqueName). This is the purchase order number with its version, or the ERP PO number (ERPPONumber).

params.name: lineItemNumber
params.description: The line item number within the purchase order (NumberOnPO)

items.docs: Retrieves details for a specific line item within a purchase order identified by its line number (NumberOnPO).
